title: Perceptual Similarity Evaluation
intro: Compare a reference synthesizer sound with Candidates A and B, then choose which candidate sounds closer.
internal_testing_notice: Internal team prototype only. These answers are development/testing data, not research-participant data. Do not recruit external participants until the supervisor and ethics process permits it.
instructions: Use headphones in a quiet environment if available.
Play the reference, Candidate A, and Candidate B at least once before answering.
Choose the candidate that sounds more perceptually similar to the reference; focus on overall timbre rather than loudness alone.
Rate how confident you are in that choice from 1 to 5. Replay any sound as often as needed.

choice.label: Which candidate sounds closer to the reference?

confidence.label: How confident are you in this choice?
